name: Orbit
desc: A tiny spacecraft caught between gravitational fields: orbit planets to dodge enemies, slingshot between gravity wells and collect energy orbs, while planets explode around you. The twist — enemies have their own gravity, pulling you off course. An original Arcade Phantasm game; pure HTML5, no dependencies.
controls: Left/Right or A/D turn, Up/W thrust, Down/S brake, P/Esc pause, M mute
creator: CursedPrograms
